snippet.title: Caves of Qud - Release Date Trailer - Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
The award-winning science fantasy roguelike is coming to Nintendo Switch on February 16th!  Learn more: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/caves-of-qud-switch/

In collaboration with Laundry Bear Games (https://laundrybear.com/)
Narrator: Justice Washington (https://justicewashington.net/)
Audio Designer Michelle del Mundo (https://www.ashellinthepit.com/)
Music: Craig Hamilton (https://soundcloud.com/craigoryham)

🍄 Available now on: 🍄
Steam: https://bit.ly/3DxY9LY
itch.io: https://bit.ly/452PZXP
Gog: https://bit.ly/44OjGMv

Developed by Freehold Games, published by Kitfox Games.
 -----------------------------------------
